title: Bias and Discrimination in AI: a cross-disciplinary perspective
findings: The paper's only finding related to religion is its identification as a legally protected characteristic. It cites Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964, which prohibits employment discrimination based on religion, alongside race, sex, and national origin, as part of the legal framework for understanding discrimination.

measurement_description: The paper is a survey and does not conduct any benchmark measurements. It mentions religion as a legally protected attribute under US law (Title VII), which would be a relevant axis for discrimination measurement, but does not perform any such measurement itself.
